name: Kimpton Gray Hotel Chicago
positioning: Kimpton hotel in a former office building in Chicago's Financial District, with a rooftop lounge and a law library-themed bar
best_for: Travelers who want several bars and restaurants in the building
Visitors who want to walk to Millennium Park and the Art Institute of Chicago

facts.text: The hotel is in the Financial District of Chicago's Loop.
The building first served as an office building before becoming a hotel.
Pets are welcome at no extra charge, regardless of size, weight or breed.
Condé Nast Traveler describes the beds as excellent, with leather headboards.
Spa rooms have a glassed-in shower room tiled in abstract designs.
Millennium Park is 0.5 miles from the hotel.
The Art Institute of Chicago is 0.4 miles from the hotel.

highlights.text: Boleo is a rooftop restaurant and lounge with a retractable glass roof on the 15th floor.
Vol. 39 is a law library-themed bar off the lobby.
Vol. 39 specializes in rare, hard-to-find wine vintages served in high-end stemware.
The hotel is in a former insurance building.
Fillmore is a chef-driven new American restaurant at the hotel.

considerations.text: The hotel does not have a pool.
Self-parking costs 64 USD per day and valet parking costs 83 USD per day.
The hotel does not offer a complimentary local area shuttle.

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: Kimpton Gray Hotel
